summary: Feb-2026 multi-command chain routing bug fix VERIFIED end-to-end on preview URL. Backend regression + frontend E2E both pass. All three entry points (AUTO INVESTIGATE, DECODE/NIVXRAY DECODE, Smart Decode) correctly split multi-line pastes and route through /api/decode/chain, syncing top-level state and auto-opening ChainStageEditor. Single-line inputs remain unaffected (backward-compat preserved).
critical_code_review_comments: splitCommandLines heuristic in /app/frontend/src/lib/commandSplitter.js correctly collapses the 11 raw lines of the requested 6-stage payload into 6 logical stages by treating `$var=...` and `IEX $var` as script continuations that glue to the preceding command line. Shared between ChainStageEditor and WorkspacePage — single source of truth. Good.

All three entry points (nivxrayDecode line 427, autoDecode line 504, autoInvestigate line ~685) call splitCommandLines(input) early and return via runChainAnalysis(parts) when >=2 stages detected. Consistent implementation.

runChainAnalysis (line 325) fully syncs top-level state: output, steps (recipe), chain, decodeTrace, decodeWinnerEngine (`chain (N stages)`), decodeConfidence (mean), analysis.{iocs, mitre, lolbins, lolbas, yara, risk, family, ai_verdict, chain_result}, plus auto-opens ChainStageEditor via setPendingChainStages/setChainEditorKey/setChainOpen. Complete fix.

Minor: nivxrayDecode's post-chain status (`CHAIN COMPLETE · 6 stages · Malicious …`) is briefly overwritten by ChainStageEditor's auto-run which resets to `ANALYSIS COMPLETE · Malicious`. Cosmetic only — chain aggregate panels, IOCs, MITRE all render correctly. Not a blocker.
seed_data_creation: Created 4 investigations via UI (1 single-line PS -Enc, 2 six-stage chain via AUTO INVESTIGATE + NIVXRAY DECODE, 1 blank-line 2-stage). All test payloads use example.com / evil.com / malicious-domain.com — no live IOCs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The `btn-auto-investigate` testid is on TWO buttons (top toolbar + input-panel inline). Use `.first` or prefer `btn-auto-investigate-inline` to avoid strict-mode collisions. `btn-nivxray-decode` is unique. Chain stage inputs use `chain-input-{idx}`. Status transitions: `MULTI-COMMAND CHAIN DETECTED · analysing N stages…` → `CHAIN COMPLETE · N stages · <verdict> · <family> · avg NN%`. When paste-hint appears, dismiss via `btn-dismiss-paste-hint` before clicking action buttons (paste-hint banner is inside INPUT panel and doesn't overlap top toolbar, but dismissing yields more deterministic runs). Chain aggregate response for the exact 6-stage payload: family='Generic PowerShell Downloader', verdict='Malicious', avg confidence ~72%, contains T1140/T1105/T1059.003.
